additionalDescription: The hardest part of building Cactus Plant was handling edge cases — network partitions, out-of-order messages, and conflicting edits. We spent months perfecting our CRDT implementation to ensure that no matter what happens, data is never lost and conflicts are resolved deterministically.
highlights: Implemented CRDT-based conflict resolution for seamless collaboration
Built a presence system showing real-time cursor positions and selections
Created an efficient binary protocol reducing bandwidth by 70%
Designed horizontal scaling architecture supporting 100k+ concurrent users
